$comment: Forbidden claims and their scope. A match fails `node scripts/verify-claims.mjs`. Add `claims-ok: <reason>` on the same line to opt out; every opt-out is printed by the gate so the exemption is never silent.

rules.reason: Rooms are encrypted in transit only — the Worker mints the room secret, so it could derive the key. E2E becomes claimable only when the Circle work (M3/M4) proves zero-knowledge.

rules.pattern: (?:關閉分頁|关闭标签页)[，, ]*一切(?:即|都)?消失
rules.reason: Closing a tab does not erase server-stored Temporary Spaces or browser-local saved items.

rules.pattern: \bnothing (?:is |is ever |ever )?(?:stored|kept)\b|\bno (?:server )?storage\b|\bno (?:data|files(?:, messages, or metadata)?) (?:is|are) (?:ever )?stored\b|\bnever stored on (?:a|any) server\b|\b(?:rooms (?:keep|store)|keep) nothing\b|leave nothing on our servers|\bno copy is stored\b|\bno account, no history, no copy\b|never sees a file|(?:server|service).{0,40}never sees? (?:your content|file contents|content)
rules.reason: Temporary Spaces hold items for a chosen duration, and the server keeps room state, IPs, sizes and times. An absolute is false; say what is actually true.
The service sees IP addresses, times and sizes. Aggregate counters are anonymous; the product is not.
True only until free-tier limits are reached; the product degrades rather than dying.
There are per-item and per-space caps; 'unlimited' is a promise the server breaks.
Counts come from the metrics service, never from copy. A hard-coded number is an invented one.
Space file storage is disabled (R2 binding commented out). Text and links only until it ships.

rules.pattern: appears automatically|appears under Available|appears in the Nearby list while
rules.reason: Nearby is OFF by default for 10 minutes at a time. A device nobody turned on cannot appear, so "appears automatically" describes a product we do not ship and makes the page's own instructions fail.

rules.pattern: while ShareTexts is open|Visible while ShareTexts is open|only while ShareTexts
rules.reason: Visibility is a 10-minute switch you turn on, not a side effect of a tab being open. "While ShareTexts is open" is the sentence that sent the owner looking for a device that was never announced.
